page_title: ESP 2-2 CEL | Espanyol v Celta Vigo 14/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+9' A lofted cross finds an unmarked Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo), who leaps high and powers a header at goal. However, his header goes miles over the bar. Poor effort.
90+8' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
90+7' Tyrhys Dolan (Espanyol) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
90+7' Kike Garcia (Espanyol) is adjudged offside.

90+6' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) finds himself some space to meet a beautiful cross from the free kick, and from near the penalty spot he attempts to score with a header. His effort lacks accuracy and goes well wide of the right post.
90+6' There is a free kick near the sideline to Espanyol.
90+4' Guillermo Cuadra shows the yellow card to Leandro Cabrera (Espanyol) for a heavy challenge.
90+3' 2 - 2 Goal! Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) fires home from very close range after latching on to a pass from Pablo Duran. The score is 2:2.
90+1' Celta Vigo enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
90' There will be a minimum of 8 min. of added time.
90' That was close. Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) fires a shot from the edge of the box which goes a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Espanyol.
89' The corner is swung in but Celta Vigo can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

89' The game is pretty dull as Celta Vigo are just passing the ball from player to player. Nothing lasts forever, though, and they finally make a mistake, allowing the opposition to pick up the ball. The ball is out of play and Celta Vigo manage to earn a corner.
88' Here is a change. Miguel Roman is going off and Claudio Giraldez gives the last tactical orders to Matias Vecino (Celta Vigo).
87' It's time for a substitution. Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) comes on in place of Javier Rodriguez.
86' 2 - 1 Tyrhys Dolan (Espanyol) has acres of space after latching on to a precise pass into the box. He doesn't hesitate to release a low effort which ends up in the middle of the net.
85' Espanyol take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

85' Espanyol are passing the ball across the pitch and keep possession. However, an opponent intercepts a pass and the situation changes. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Espanyol.
83' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ramon Terrats (Espanyol) comes onto the pitch for Roberto Fernandez Jaen.
82' The Celta Vigo players can't believe it after the referee disallows the goal after the intervention of the VAR!
80' The goal for Celta Vigo is subject to a VAR review by the referee! He's obviously unsure or he received a message.
77' Omar El Hilali (Espanyol) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
77' Goal! Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a low shot into the middle of the net. He makes it 1:2.
76' 45:55 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
74' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) finds himself unmarked on the edge of the box, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post.
73' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Celta Vigo.
72' Substitution. Pere Milla makes way for Jofre (Espanyol).
71' The free kick from long range, taken by Espanyol, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
70' Claudio Giraldez prepares a substitution. Ferran Jutgla is replaced by Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo).
70' Claudio Giraldez has decided to make a change. Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) replaces Javier Rueda.
70' It will be a substitution. Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) is ready to enter the pitch as Williot Swedberg walks off.
66' 1 - 1 Kike Garcia (Espanyol) produces a moment of pure magic and scores a spectacular goal by striking the ball into the top left corner of the net!
64' Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
61' Neat passing move from Celta Vigo in order to create new attacking opportunities.
60' Javier Rueda (Celta Vigo) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
59' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players. The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo will have a goal kick.
57' Javier Rueda (Celta Vigo) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
57' Omar El Hilali (Espanyol) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
56' Here comes a substitution. Tyrhys Dolan (Espanyol) is brought on as a substitute for Charles Pickel.
56' Manolo Gonzalez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Kike Garcia (Espanyol) replacing Cyril Ngonge.
56' Substitution. Urko Gonzalez (Espanyol) on for Exposito.
52' The Celta Vigo players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
52' One of the Celta Vigo players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
50' Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
49' Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Guillermo Cuadra has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
48' Celta Vigo fail to score from a corner as Marko Dmitrovic (Espanyol) leaps to collect the ball.

48' Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a terrific shot from the edge of the box towards the top right corner, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one! Celta Vigo have been awarded a corner kick.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' Cyril Ngonge (Espanyol) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
45+2' Referee Guillermo Cuadra sees the trip by Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
45+2' Fernando Lopez (Celta Vigo) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
45' It seemed like Miguel Roman (Celta Vigo) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
44' Guillermo Cuadra interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Exposito (Espanyol). Celta Vigo have been awarded a free kick.
44' Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
42' Rough tackle by Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.

42' Williot Swedberg nearly gets in a one-on-one with the goalkeeper after a defence-splitting pass from Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo), but one of the defenders makes a clearance to snuff out the chance. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Celta Vigo.
40' The referee blows for a cooling break.
38' 0 - 1 Goal! A precise cut back on the goal line from Javier Rueda finds Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo) right in front of goal, and he easily buries the ball into the bottom left corner. 0:1.
36' Cyril Ngonge (Espanyol) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
36' Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee. Espanyol have a free kick from a promising distance.
35' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
33' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) tackles a bit over-zealously and Guillermo Cuadra blows for a foul.

31' Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo) missed a great opportunity! He finds himself some space near the penalty spot and plants a header goalwards which lacks both power and accuracy. The ball goes well wide of the right post! The ball goes out of play and Espanyol will have a goal kick.
30' The Celta Vigo players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
28' Cyril Ngonge (Espanyol) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
27' The keeper makes a simple save after Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) received a short pass and shot low from the edge of the box towards the middle of the goal.
26' The number of shots on goal at present is 1:0.
25' Surely that's handball by one of the Celta Vigo players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
23' Espanyol are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
21' Charles Pickel (Espanyol) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
20' Pere Milla (Espanyol) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
19' Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle. Carl Starfelt (Celta Vigo) commits a foul after dangerous play.

18' That was close by Javier Rodriguez (Celta Vigo)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Espanyol.
17' Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle after Charles Pickel (Espanyol) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
14' Clemens Riedel (Espanyol) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
13' Espanyol seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
11' Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
10' Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle for a foul.
9' Javier Rueda (Celta Vigo) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Marko Dmitrovic intercepts the ball.
9' Clemens Riedel (Espanyol) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
8' The game is interrupted now, Clemens Riedel (Espanyol) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
7' Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo) commits a rough foul. Guillermo Cuadra stops the game and makes a call.
5' The resulting set piece from Espanyol is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

5' Exposito (Espanyol) releases a powerful first-time effort from the edge of the box which goes in the direction of the bottom right corner of the target, but the keeper leaps like a salmon to deny him. Excellent goalkeeping! The ball is out of play. Espanyol win a corner kick.

4' Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Guillermo Cuadra blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
2' Miguel Roman (Celta Vigo) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Espanyol will have the kick-off.
Guillermo Cuadra will supervise the game today.
